comment: Full library for board rev. 1.3/1.3.1 (make full -> build-full/): Llegamos tarde first, the ports, Nitro Nonsense (from the devkit), Llegamos tarde (Platanus Hack 26 edition; its original has no license yet) and the Tiny games that fit. All games are built with games/common/sysx.c (UP + DOWN held 2 s: back to the menu; low-battery beep, except Nitro Nonsense). The Tiny games are rebuilt from source (games/tiny). Data regions and save slots are fixed addresses. Nitro Nonsense and MicroCity keep their code overlays as LZ streams that the kernel unpacks. No Board Test: the EEPROM test scratch (test_scratch false) holds programs. Left out for room: Tiny Invaders, Tiny Pacman, Tiny Tris, Tiny Boulder, Tiny Bubble, Board Test, Tiny Arkanoid, Tiny Doom, Tiny Run, Tiny Shooter, Tiny Karate.
